purpose: Convert retained work into integrated, canonical, deployed, and maintainable estate value without allowing activity volume to conceal unpaid obligations.
payment_rule: An obligation is collected only when the estate-facing state it was meant to improve is canonically adopted, integrated to main, deployed where applicable, validated on the deployed object, and protected against quiet recurrence. Evidence packets are recoverable assets, not final payment.

liabilities.mechanism: A long serial branch and PR stack preserves work while preventing it from becoming reviewable, mergeable, and deployable estate value.
liabilities.payment: Create one exact-head consolidation transaction against current main, reconcile the nine mainline commits, preserve a machine-readable supersession map for every stacked PR, pass the full repository gate, and close superseded PRs only after their retained objects are proven present.
liabilities.stop_condition: No new independent estate frontier may be opened while the consolidation transaction is absent or failing, except work already authorized by the active unattended card-backfill campaign.

liabilities.venue: canonical card data, source ledger, media audit, rendered site
liabilities.mechanism: The evidence factory creates validated packets while canonical mutation remains false, so every accepted packet also creates an adoption obligation.
liabilities.payment: Run bounded canonical-adoption batches from exact packet manifests, mutate only the authorized record/side, rebuild projections once per batch, pass duplicate and rendered-browser gates, and retain acceptance or rejection receipts.
liabilities.stop_condition: Evidence packet production must not be reported as estate completion and must not outrun canonical-adoption capacity without an explicit debt-cap exception.

liabilities.venue: sitewide absent portrait and still facets
liabilities.mechanism: Verified absences remain visible estate gaps until exact evidence is found or a typed terminal disposition proves that the current frontier is exhausted.
liabilities.payment: Continue policy-bound autonomous discovery, independent adjudication, retained failure custody, and permanent packet publication until the target is reached or a typed stop condition is proven.
liabilities.stop_condition: Discovery may continue unattended, but cannot erase failed attempts, weaken custody, or conceal adoption and integration balances.

liabilities.mechanism: The entire card-backfill stack inherits from an unresolved Ferengi branch and a website-maintenance handoff that explicitly required replay onto current main after the root transaction was resolved.
liabilities.payment: Adjudicate the surviving Ferengi claims against current main, preserve valid corrections, retire obsolete gold assertions, then replay the website-maintenance boundary onto the resulting exact head.
liabilities.stop_condition: No downstream branch may claim mainline or deployed completion while the root dependency remains unresolved.

liabilities.mechanism: PR 88 canonically backfills a set of facets that overlaps records later represented by evidence-only packets, creating a risk of duplicate work, conflicting source choices, or ambiguous supersession.
liabilities.payment: Generate an exact record/side/hash reconciliation table declaring each PR 88 candidate retained, superseded, rejected, or identical to the later permanent packet before either lane is integrated.
liabilities.stop_condition: No overlapping record/side may be canonically adopted from more than one lane without an explicit winner and a retained rejection receipt for the other candidate.

liabilities.mechanism: The experiment describes and tests an older parent state while the production lane has advanced, so its measured result can become detached from the active policy and denominator.
liabilities.payment: Rebase or replay the experiment onto the exact current parent, preserve prior run receipts as historical evidence, rerun its fixtures and live cohort, then merge the policy delta or close the superseded experiment.
liabilities.stop_condition: No source-policy experiment may become active from a stale parent or report yield against an obsolete denominator.

liabilities.mechanism: Repository gates prove candidate integrity but do not prove that merged output is the object served publicly or that the live routes retain the intended media and navigation behavior.
liabilities.payment: After mainline integration, capture the deployed commit, route inventory, media hashes, rendered-browser results, and rollback boundary from the live Pages object.
liabilities.stop_condition: No collection item is closed at merge time when the obligation affects the public site.

liabilities.venue: workflows, recovery files, controls, and superseded policies
liabilities.mechanism: Successful recovery and policy experiments can leave obsolete workflows and controls that increase maintenance cost, ambiguity, and accidental execution risk.
liabilities.payment: Classify every workflow and control as active, retained evidence, superseded, or removable; delete only after its successor and historical receipts are proven; add a gate that rejects undocumented active card-backfill workflows.
liabilities.stop_condition: A new workflow must name the workflow or control it supersedes, or state that it creates a new permanent responsibility.

next_transaction.title: Build exact-head consolidation and supersession map
outputs: one consolidation branch against current main
next_transaction.success: Every retained object has exactly one forward path to main and every obsolete PR has an exact successor or explicit terminal ruling.
